251: Haruhi Suzumiya is the founding member of the SOS Brigade with the purpose of finding aliens, time travelers and espers. She is incredibly eccentric and usually anti-social, with no interest in "ordinary" humans.
2169: Konata Izumi is, more by default than anything else, the "leader" of the main characters. Nicknamed "Kona-chan" by her friends, she is an eccentric but friendly and outgoing girl, with a mischievous but good-natured sense of humor.
2170: Tsukasa is the younger fraternal twin sister of Kagami and lives in a six-member family household with her parents. She is in the same class as Konata though isn't good at studying or at sports, but excels in cooking. Tsukasa's physique is a little smaller than average.
2171: Kagami is the older fraternal twin sister of Tsukasa. In school, her grades are excellent and she studies very hard. She was even the class president of her class in her first year.
2172: Miyuki is a "young lady" from a wealthy family whom is also beautiful, smart, and well-mannered. She was the president for her grade level in her first year when she became great friends with Kagami. Now Miyuki is the same class as Konata and Tsukasa.
2309: Akira is a junior high school student who is also the captain of the Lucky ☆ Star informational ad section called "Lucky Channel" in the Comptiq magazine.
2728: Shiraishi Minoru serves as Akira's co-host on the Lucky Channel. Starting as a shy and frightened host, by each episode he gains more confidence and eventually becomes very energetic and starts to overshadow Akira, which easily annoys her.
2729: Soujirou Izumi is the father of Konata Izumi and an author who works at home. He loves watching anime and playing video games, which influenced his daughter's interests. Soujirou is "also a lolicon".
2885: Nanako is the homeroom teacher for Konata's class and her primary subject is world history. She thinks that students have it easy because as she has said, "you guys don't have to think about what to wear every day.
2936: Yui is Konata's cousin and is a female police officer for the Saitama Prefectural Police Department. She is very easy-going and is a cop who acts before thinking. She is a bit of a klutz and is a meganekko. However, she has a tendency to road rage when she's behind the wheel.
3224: Izumi Konata's mother and Izumi Soujiro's wife, who is now deceased. Very small in stature and was mistaken for Konata in a photograph that Kagami and Tsukasa saw.
3245: Minami is a very quiet girl who does not show much emotion, hence her being often mistaken for being cold, but she is very kind at heart. She comes from a wealthy family, and she lives across the street from Miyuki Takara.
3246: Yutaka, a very positive and cheerful but sometimes forgetful girl, is Konata's cousin and Yui's younger sister. Also referred to as "Yu-chan" by Konata and Sōjirō. When Konata became a third year student, she was admitted to Ryōō Gakuen High School as a first year student.
4130: Meito Anizawa, also known as Anime Tenchou, is the manager of the Animate shop that Konata regularly visits; he was originally the mascot of Animate. He and his staff consider Konata their most valued customer known as "Legendary Girl A" and go to great lengths to sell to her.
4181: Hiyori is a doujin artist who is also a classmate of Yutaka and Minami. Additionally, she is an otaku who creates her own dōjinshi; her genres are broad, stretching from shōnen-ai to yuri. Hiyori is always searching for a good plot to use in her dōjinshi.
4229: She is a transfer student from the United States. She is in the same class as Yutaka and Minami. She has short blonde hair and blue eyes. Patricia loves anime and manga and has learned all her Japanese through them, so in effect her Japanese is very weird.
4230: Ayano is Kagami's classmate and has been in the same class with Kagami for the past five years since middle school; she is a childhood friend of Misao, a young girl on the dream.
4231: Misao is Kagami's classmate and has been in the same class with Kagami and Ayano for the past five years since middle school; she is a childhood friend of Ayano's. Misao tends to be simple minded and an outdoor type of person. She is in the cross-country club and hates studying.
6009: A tough-talking "Yankee" called Gotouther-sama by Shiraishi and Akira. She is feared and respected, and gets mad seeing the trashed Lucky Channel set. She drives a motorcycle and carries around a wooden sword.
6384: Daisuke Ono temporarily replaces Minoru Shiraishi as Akira Kogami's co-host on the Lucky Channel when Minoru gets sent to Mt. Fuji.
11985: Voice Actress for Konata Izumi and Haruhi Suzumiya makes a cameo in a concert, Suzumiya Haruhi no Gekisō, in episode 15, "I Can't Suddenly Change"
15057: Yukari Takara is Miyuki Takara's mother, who tends to be very well-mannered, but can be a bit of a klutz. She is warm and friendly, once talking with a telemarketer for over an hour, and has a mischievous sense of humor.
16547: Hinata Miyakawa is a young girl with long salmon pink hair, which she ties just a bit to the left of her forehead with a rabbit clip; she has pink droopy eyes and is a meganekko. She makes a living through a job at a local doujin shop.
21967: Voice Actress for Minami Iwasaki and Yuki Nagato makes a cameo in Comiket 71 in episode 12, "Let's Go to the Festival".
24284: Matsuri is the second oldest sister in the Hiiragi family. She is a college student and a miko at the Takanomiya Shrine. She tends to be less dependable than Inori, the eldest sister, when helping their younger twin sisters with school work.
25596: Inori is the eldest sister of the Hiiragi sisters. Just like her younger sister, Matsuri, she is also a miko at the Takanomiya Shrine.
28752: She is the mother of Tsukasa and Kagami
32004: Tadao Hiiragi is the father of the Hiiragi family and has short black hair. He works as the priest of the Takanomiya Shrine. As a parent, he often makes sure that his daughters are doing their school work, and checks on their progress.
41521: He's a worker at Gamers, He is only in the anime in one episode for a couple of seconds
43550: Hikage is a short, temperamental girl and the youngest in the entire cast of Lucky Star. She is the younger sister of Hinata Miyakawa.
51047: Hikaru Sakuraba is the biology teacher at Ryōō High School, and is the homeroom teacher of Kagami's class 3-C. She is also the captain of the Lucky Star informational ad section, which was renamed "Lucky Paradise". She is feared by Akira, but Akira later calls Hikaru a betrayer.
